tips.title: 3 of 12 exchanges retyped a question you had already asked (2 repeated question(s), one sent 3 times): about 0.089 to 0.354 Wh was spent re-answering them

examples: How do I center a div in CSS on my ZEBRAQUARTZ page?
Rewrite this to sound friendlier: 'Send me the report by Friday.'

tips.how_to_fix: Keep the first answer of each repeated question in a saved snippet or note, and edit or continue that same thread instead of sending the question again.

tips.title: 1 answers were retried (1 flagged regenerated, 1 questions resent within 30 minutes), burning about 0.007 to 0.027 Wh

examples: Rewrite this to sound friendlier: 'Send me the report by Friday.'

tips.how_to_fix: Before regenerating, tell the model what was wrong with the previous answer and ask for a targeted edit, so one reply replaces a retry.

tips.title: 1 of 2 short asks (50%) ran on gpt-4o, where gpt-4o-mini would use 83 to 83% less energy: about 0.003 to 0.014 Wh recoverable

examples: And only keep the even ones?

tips.how_to_fix: Route simple lookups, rewrites and short questions to gpt-4o-mini and keep gpt-4o for the hard problems that actually need it.
